text.en: The adjectival suffix *-an*, originally a verb meaning 'to exist', forms adjectives from nouns and derives demonstrative and interrogative adjectives from pronouns ⟦claim:nominal/no-adjective-class-property-verbs--the-adjectival-suffix-an-originally-a-verb-meaning⟧. From body-part and related nouns, the suffix *-ash* forms adjectives that describe physical or personal attributes ⟦claim:nominal/no-adjective-class-property-verbs--the-suffix-ash-forms-adjectives-describing-physical-or⟧. Historically, the adjectival suffix *-ush* represents the plural of *-un* ⟦claim:nominal/no-adjective-class-property-verbs--the-adjectival-suffix-ush-is-historically-the-plural⟧. The suffix *-o*, originally a verb meaning 'to be inside' or 'to be attached to', forms adjectives from nouns ⟦claim:nominal/no-adjective-class-property-verbs--the-adjectival-suffix-o-originally-a-verb-meaning⟧. The suffix *-nu* attaches to nouns with the meaning 'abundant in' and attaches to *-ash* adjectives to intensify their meaning ⟦claim:nominal/no-adjective-class-property-verbs--the-suffix-nu-attaches-to-nouns-to-mean⟧. Originally a verb meaning 'to be', the suffix *-ne* developed from expressing '-shaped' or 'like...' into a widely used adjectival suffix ⟦claim:nominal/no-adjective-class-property-verbs--the-adjectival-suffix-ne-originally-a-verb-meaning⟧. The suffix *-kor*, originally a verb meaning 'to have', derives adjectives indicating possession of a quality or feature ⟦claim:nominal/no-adjective-class-property-verbs--the-adjectival-suffix-kor-originally-a-verb-meaning⟧. Privative adjectives are formed by *-sak*, which was originally a verb meaning 'to lack' ⟦claim:nominal/no-adjective-class-property-verbs--the-adjectival-suffix-sak-originally-a-verb-meaning⟧. Historically, the suffix *-nak* is derived from *-sak* ⟦claim:nominal/no-adjective-class-property-verbs--the-adjectival-suffix-nak-is-derived-historically-from⟧. The suffix *-ke* derives adjectives from noun roots or onomatopoetic stems ⟦claim:nominal/no-adjective-class-property-verbs--the-adjectival-suffix-ke-forms-adjectives-from-noun⟧. In deriving adjectives from verbs, the suffix *-no* adds the meaning 'well' or 'proficiently' ⟦claim:nominal/no-adjective-class-property-verbs--the-suffix-no-imparts-the-meaning-well-or⟧. The suffix *-ko* attaches to adjectives to convey an opposite meaning ⟦claim:nominal/no-adjective-class-property-verbs--the-suffix-ko-attaches-to-adjectives-to-impart⟧. Functioning as an adjective ending, *-ma* appears in *tuima* 'distant', *ramma* 'constant', and *moshma* 'other' ⟦claim:nominal/no-adjective-class-property-verbs--the-ending-ma-functions-as-an-adjective-ending⟧. The ending *-tek* forms property verbs or adjectives, as in *kuttek* 'black', *sattek* 'thin, emaciated', *rettek* 'decrepit, aged', and *yautek* 'cooled down' ⟦claim:nominal/no-adjective-class-property-verbs--the-ending-tek-forms-property-verbs-adjectives-as⟧.
text.ja: 形容詞語尾*-an*は元来「ある」という意味の動詞であり、名詞から形容詞を派生するほか、代名詞から指示形容詞や疑問形容詞を形成する⟦claim:nominal/no-adjective-class-property-verbs--the-adjectival-suffix-an-originally-a-verb-meaning⟧。接尾辞*-ash*は身体部位などの名詞から属性を表す形容詞をつくる⟦claim:nominal/no-adjective-class-property-verbs--the-suffix-ash-forms-adjectives-describing-physical-or⟧。形容詞語尾*-ush*は歴史的には*-un*の複数形に由来する⟦claim:nominal/no-adjective-class-property-verbs--the-adjectival-suffix-ush-is-historically-the-plural⟧。元来「はいっている」または「ついている」という意味の動詞であった形容詞語尾*-o*は、名詞から形容詞を形成する⟦claim:nominal/no-adjective-class-property-verbs--the-adjectival-suffix-o-originally-a-verb-meaning⟧。接尾辞*-nu*は名詞に付いて「…が多い」という意味の形容詞をつくり、*-ash*形容詞に付いてその意味を強める⟦claim:nominal/no-adjective-class-property-verbs--the-suffix-nu-attaches-to-nouns-to-mean⟧。元来「である」という意味の動詞であった形容詞語尾*-ne*は、「……状の」「……のような」という意味から広く形容詞語尾となった⟦claim:nominal/no-adjective-class-property-verbs--the-adjectival-suffix-ne-originally-a-verb-meaning⟧。元来「もつ」という意味の動詞であった形容詞語尾*-kor*は、性質や特徴を有することを表す形容詞をつくる⟦claim:nominal/no-adjective-class-property-verbs--the-adjectival-suffix-kor-originally-a-verb-meaning⟧。元来「を缺く」という意味の動詞であった形容詞語尾*-sak*は、欠如を表す形容詞をつくる⟦claim:nominal/no-adjective-class-property-verbs--the-adjectival-suffix-sak-originally-a-verb-meaning⟧。形容詞語尾*-nak*は歴史的に*-sak*に由来する⟦claim:nominal/no-adjective-class-property-verbs--the-adjectival-suffix-nak-is-derived-historically-from⟧。接尾辞*-ke*は名詞語根や擬声語語幹などから形容詞をつくる⟦claim:nominal/no-adjective-class-property-verbs--the-adjectival-suffix-ke-forms-adjectives-from-noun⟧。接尾辞*-no*は動詞に「よく」という意味を添えて形容詞をつくる⟦claim:nominal/no-adjective-class-property-verbs--the-suffix-no-imparts-the-meaning-well-or⟧。接尾辞*-ko*は形容詞に付いて反対の意味を添える⟦claim:nominal/no-adjective-class-property-verbs--the-suffix-ko-attaches-to-adjectives-to-impart⟧。語尾*-ma*は形容詞語尾として機能し、*tuima*「遠い」、*ramma*「常住の」、*moshma*「他の」などに見られる⟦claim:nominal/no-adjective-class-property-verbs--the-ending-ma-functions-as-an-adjective-ending⟧。語尾*-tek*は、*kuttek*「黒い」、*sattek*「痩せた」、*rettek*「老衰した」、*yautek*「冷却した」のように形容詞（状態動詞）を形成する⟦claim:nominal/no-adjective-class-property-verbs--the-ending-tek-forms-property-verbs-adjectives-as⟧。
